name: A Painting of You
source:
Groggy mornings, half-finished homework, and playful classmates. A routine day turns unexpectedly lively when small adventures and fleeting encounters add sparks to college life.

[From [url=https://sheepwrekty.itch.io/apoy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
昏昏沉沉的早晨，完成了一半的作业，还有顽皮的同学。当小小的冒险和短暂的邂逅为大学生活增添火花时，平淡的一天会变得出乎意料地热闹。

[来自[url=https://sheepwrekty.itch.io/apoy]Itch.io[/url]]
